### Job's Trials Intensify
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/jobs-trials-intensify
Passage: Job 2:9-10
Points:
- Satan claimed that Job's devotion was superficial and would vanish once his physical health was destroyed.
- God allowed Satan to afflict Job's body to prove that God is worthy of love for who He is, not just for the gifts He gives.
- Even when his wife urged him to curse God and die, Job steadfastly refused to sin with his speech.
- Job affirmed that God has sovereign authority over all circumstances, ordaining both prosperity and adversity.
- Believers are honored to serve as instruments through whom God's glory and supreme worth are displayed amid hardship.
